entries.message: Site Controls now describes a site’s connection the same way whichever engine shows the page.
Decide in the core which Spaces' extensions may change, where an extension's copies go, and which consent answers an install, for any engine that runs extensions.
Download and install Chrome Web Store packages in the portable Chromium binding, asking the core rather than a window whether each install may go ahead.
An extension managed by a policy no longer offers to enable, disable, pin or remove it, and a copy of an extension stops when the Space it goes to starts being deleted.
When an extension chosen during import can’t be installed in one Space, the other Spaces that chose it still receive it.
An extension chosen during import still reaches its other Spaces when one of them is being deleted while the extension installs.
